shots.what: title card: a happy cloud in a blue sky, the title, then three elephants pop in hanging from it on strings and the cloud starts to sweat
a person on a green hill looks up at the cloud far above; a question mark pops on 'hanging'
the cloud inside a see-through cube drawn on 'kilometer'; 1 km measures on wide, tall and deep
a magnifier on one cubic meter of the cloud: a small cube with a few droplets, '1 m3' then '0.5 g'
an almost empty glass with one tiny drop at the bottom; tag NOT EVEN A SIP
the cube around the cloud fills with a grid of little cubes; a counter rolls to 1,000,000,000 m3
streams of droplets pour into one giant drop that swells; 500 TONNES slams on
low angle: a tiny person under a huge cloud with a giant water drop showing through it; the person flinches on 'head'
the cloud wonders (question mark); a cutaway window opens on 'does': droplets inside drifting down slowly
a blob of water bursts into hundreds of droplets, then the camera dives at one tiny droplet
one droplet with a face sinks slowly beside a ruler; a stopwatch ticks; pill '~1 cm per second'
the sun warms the ground; wavy orange arrows of warm air rise from it and push into the cloud
a huge orange arrow up (air: a few m/s) beside a tiny blue arrow down (drop: ~1 cm/s); the droplets ride the big arrow back up
the see-through cube again; it fills with air molecules on 'air', the cloud faint inside
a balance scale: a small drop of water on the left pan, a big bag of air on the right; it slams down on the air side; 1,000x
the cloud as a champion in a spotlight, a gold belt, a smug face; LIGHTWEIGHT
droplets drifting in the dark start bumping into each other and merging into bigger ones
droplets swarm from everywhere into one big raindrop; a counter to 1,000,000; the raindrop pops out with a face
the raindrop under the cloud, the warm air arrows straining to hold it; TOO HEAVY; on 'falls' it drops out of frame
rain from the cloud over the person with an umbrella; an elephant shape shows through the cloud on 'elephants'; one big drop lands on the umbrella at the end
